description: 2.5MHz Step-down type Adjustable 800mV~58.8V 3.5A SOIC-8-EP Voltage Regulators - DC DC Switching Regulators RoHS

parameters.Features: Cycle-by-cycle current limiting;Light load efficient mode;Frequency synchronization;External compensation;Overcurrent Protection

notes: Chosen specifically for 5 V bus operation. Its automatic BOOT recharge circuit allows 'duty cycles approaching 100%', so 'the maximum output voltage is near the minimum input supply voltage' (datasheet p.10). An ordinary buck cannot produce 5 V from a 5 V input; this one passes through.
4.5-60 V in, 3.5 A, internal UVLO 4.3 V rising.

Dropout formula, datasheet p.12: VINmin = (VOUT + VF + Rdc*IOUT)/0.99 + RDSon*IOUT - VF. At 0.7 A this gives a 4.60 V rail from a 4.75 V bus (USB-C low tolerance), 4.85 V from 5.00 V, and a clean 5.00 V at 5.25 V and above. All within the 74AHCT541's 4.5-5.5 V.

The sag at low bus voltage is self-correcting: the modules' XL1509 is also in pass-through at 5 V, so module VDD falls too, and WS2812 VIH is 0.7 x VDD. The level shifter and the modules track together.
designVerdict: SELECTED - bus 5-36 V to the 5 V rail
